title: Tariffs Hurt Williams-Sonoma More Than the Housing Market
summary: Williams-Sonoma  stock dropped on Wednesday even though the home specialty retailer delivered a beat-and-raise quarter in tough times for housing.  The stock is up 25% this year, but down 11% from its all-time closing high of $251.78 on Aug. 7, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  While other retailers are logging tariff refunds, Williams-Sonoma is feeling a sting.
